description: This is a test class for the LanguageService in the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It sets up tests for fetching, deleting, and retrieving language entities using mocked dependencies.

classes.name: LanguageServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the LanguageService's functionalities such as getting language list, deleting languages, and fetching language by ID or name.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageService instance and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of Language objects from the LanguageService.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Tests deletion of languages and verifies the number of deleted entries.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests fetching a Language object by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a Language object by its name.
